cards.title: Pediatrician: Human Connection Matters More Than AI
cards.body: Loss of human connection poses a greater threat to children than technology itself. The solution isn't limiting screens but spending more time talking openly with kids.

cards.title: Grandparents Can Support Kids Through Divorce
cards.body: Grandparents provide crucial emotional stability when their adult children divorce. Learn how to help grandchildren navigate family crisis without overstepping boundaries.

cards.title: Can Prenatal Depression Treatment Affect Baby's Brain?
cards.body: New research explores links between maternal depression treatment, infant brain development, and emotional health. Early intervention may have protective benefits for developing babies.

cards.title: Understanding Autistic Burnout in Children
cards.body: Low-demand parenting may reduce conflict but doesn't guarantee recovery for neurodivergent kids. Research suggests what actually supports autistic children's wellbeing beyond just avoiding stress.

cards.title: Children Deserve More Than Our Anger
cards.body: Trauma in childhood shapes how kids need protection and belonging. Healing requires understanding what safety truly means for vulnerable young people.

cards.title: Why Failure Is Necessary for Child Success
cards.body: Research in resilience psychology confirms that failure teaches children essential skills. Allowing kids to struggle builds stronger foundations for future success.

cards.title: Moms, Daughters, and College Decision-Making
cards.body: Parents hiring consultants for sorority decisions may undermine daughters' autonomy. Better support comes from modeling intentionality and self-awareness in choices.
